create.name: Celia Roberts
create.bio:
Celia Roberts is an Australian yoga and meditation teacher who founded BIYOME, her BioMedical Institute of Yoga and Meditation, at a retreat centre she opened in 2014 in the hills of Upper Brookfield on the western edge of Brisbane. She holds a degree in biomedical science and is registered as a senior yoga teacher and yoga therapist, with further study in Ayurveda, meditation, counselling and integrative medicine. Before BIYOME she co-founded an earlier yoga and integrative medicine institute, ran by-donation community yoga in Japan and Australia, and served as a volunteer with Yoga Australia, including chairing its 2016 conference.

Her teaching sets classical yoga and Vedic and Buddhist meditation beside current research, and her school trains yoga, meditation and Ayurveda teachers at levels from short intensives up to 1,000 hours, both at the centre and online. She says she has mentored more than a thousand teachers over the last decade. Alongside the trainings she leads weekly yoga classes during school terms and a monthly half-day meditation retreat at the Upper Brookfield sanctuary, exploring themes such as self-inquiry, mantra and acceptance.

courses.title: Mindfulness for a Meaningful Life: Monthly Meditation Retreats
courses.description: A monthly Friday-morning meditation gathering at the Upper Brookfield sanctuary, each session built around one theme such as self-inquiry, mantra or acceptance. Sessions can be booked one at a time or as a pack of five to use within a year.

courses.title: Yoga Classes at Upper Brookfield
courses.description: Term-time yoga classes on Tuesday and Thursday mornings that Celia teaches for all levels. Postures sit alongside meditation and short discussions of the science of practice and compassion.

courses.title: 330MTT Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: A 330-hour meditation teacher training at the centre, joining three meditation intensives with home study and a daily practice log over about nine months. It covers the philosophy, psychology and physiology of meditation and how to adapt practices for different groups.

courses.title: OL330MTT Meditation Teacher Training (Online)
courses.description: The online version of the 330-hour meditation teacher training, studied remotely with recorded content, written assessments and live Zoom practice sessions. It suits students outside Queensland who want a registered meditation teaching qualification.
